intro.en: In this lesson we read a text about protecting the environment. It says what the environment is, why we must look after it, and three causes of pollution.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum mahaul ki hifazat par ek matn parhenge. Is mein bataya gaya hai ke mahaul kya hai, uski dekh-bhaal kyun zaroori hai aur aaloodgi ke teen asbab kya hain.
intro.ar: نَقْرَأُ في هذا الدَّرْسِ نَصّاً عَنْ حِمايَةِ البيئَةِ: ما البيئَةُ، وَلِماذا يَجِبُ أَنْ نَحْفَظَها، وَما أَسْبابُ التَّلَوُّثِ الثَّلاثَةُ.

dialogue.ar: تَزْدادُ الدَّعَواتُ في أَيّامِنا إِلى حِمايَةِ البيئَةِ، لِأَنَّ التَّلَوُّثَ صارَ خَطَراً يَهُمُّ الجَميعَ.
dialogue.tr: tazdādu d-daʿawātu fī ayyāminā ilā ḥimāyati l-bīʾati, liʾanna t-talawwutha ṣāra khaṭaran yahummu l-jamīʿ.
dialogue.en: Calls to protect the environment are growing in our days, because pollution has become a danger that concerns everyone.
dialogue.ur: Aaj kal mahaul ki hifazat ki pukaren barh rahi hain, kyunke aaloodgi ek aisa khatra ban gayi hai jo sab ko mutassir karta hai.

dialogue.ar: فَما البيئَةُ؟ هِيَ كُلُّ ما يُحيطُ بِنا؛ فَالأَرْضُ بَيْتُنا، وَمِنْ ثِمارِها نَأْكُلُ.
dialogue.tr: famā l-bīʾatu? hiya kullu mā yuḥīṭu binā; fa-l-ʾarḍu baytunā, wamin thimārihā naʾkul.
dialogue.en: So what is the environment? It is everything around us: the earth is our home, and from its fruits we eat.
dialogue.ur: Phir mahaul kya hai? Yeh woh sab hai jo hamein gher hue hai: zameen hamara ghar hai aur us ke phal hum khate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالبَحْرُ مِنْها أَيْضاً؛ تَسيرُ فَوْقَهُ السُّفُنُ، وَنَصْطادُ مِنْهُ سَمَكاً نَأْكُلُ لَحْمَهُ طَرِيّاً.
dialogue.tr: wa-l-baḥru minhā ayḍan; tasīru fawqahu s-sufun, wanaṣṭādu minhu samakan naʾkulu laḥmahu ṭariyyan.
dialogue.en: The sea is part of it too; ships sail over it, and we catch fish from it and eat its meat fresh.
dialogue.ur: Samundar bhi us ka hissa hai; us par jahaz chalte hain aur hum us se machhli pakad kar us ka taaza gosht khate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالهَواءُ كَذَلِكَ، بِهِ نَتَنَفَّسُ فَنَعيشُ؛ وَالشَّمْسُ مَصْدَرُ الدِّفْءِ وَالطّاقَةِ لِلْأَحْياءِ جَميعاً.
dialogue.tr: wa-l-hawāʾu kadhalik, bihi natanaffasu fanaʿīsh; wa-sh-shamsu maṣdaru d-difʾi wa-ṭ-ṭāqati lilʾaḥiyāʾi jamīʿan.
dialogue.en: So is the air, by which we breathe and live; and the sun is the source of warmth and energy for all living things.
dialogue.ur: Hawa bhi aisi hi hai, us se hum saans le kar jeete hain; aur sooraj tamam jandaron ke liye garmi aur tawanai ka sarchashma hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهِيَ الجِبالُ الشّامِخَةُ الَّتي تُثَبِّتُ الأَرْضَ، وَالنَّباتاتُ وَالحَيَواناتُ الَّتي تَعيشُ مَعَنا.
dialogue.tr: wahiya l-jibālu sh-shāmikhatu allatī tuthabbitu l-ʾarḍ, wa-n-nabātātu wa-l-ḥayawānātu allatī taʿīshu maʿanā.
dialogue.en: It is the towering mountains that keep the earth firm, and the plants and animals that live with us.
dialogue.ur: Yeh uunche pahaad hain jo zameen ko jamaye rakhte hain aur paudhe aur janwar hain jo hamare saath rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ خَلَقَ اللهُ كُلَّ هَذا بِتَوازُنٍ دَقيقٍ، فَلا يَجوزُ أَنْ نَعْبَثَ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: waqad khalaqa Allāh kulla hādhā bitawāzunin daqīqin, falā yajūzu an naʿbatha bih.
dialogue.en: Allah created all of this with a precise balance, so we may not tamper with it.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne yeh sab nihayat nafees tawazun ke saath banaya hai, is liye hamein us se khilwad karna jaiz nahin.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ حِمايَةَ البيئَةِ مَسْؤولِيَّةُ كُلِّ إِنْسانٍ؛ الصَّغيرِ وَالكَبيرِ، وَالغَنِيِّ وَالفَقيرِ.
dialogue.tr: inna ḥimāyata l-bīʾati masʾūliyyatu kulli insānin; aṣ-ṣaghīri wa-l-kabīr, wa-l-ghaniyyi wa-l-faqīr.
dialogue.en: Protecting the environment is the responsibility of every person: young and old, rich and poor.
dialogue.ur: Mahaul ki hifazat har insan ki zimmedari hai: chhote bare, ameer gareeb sab ki.

dialogue.ar: وَلِلتَّلَوُّثِ أَسْبابٌ كَثيرَةٌ، نَذْكُرُ مِنْها ثَلاثَةً.
dialogue.tr: walilttalawwuthi asbābun kathīratun, nadhkuru minhā thalāthatan.
dialogue.en: Pollution has many causes; we mention three of them.
dialogue.ur: Aaloodgi ke bohat se asbab hain, hum un mein se teen zikr karte hain.

dialogue.ar: السَّبَبُ الأَوَّلُ: المَصانِعُ الكَبيرَةُ الَّتي تَنْفُثُ دُخانَها في الهَواءِ وَتُلْقي نِفاياتِها في الأَنْهارِ، وَتَسْتَهْلِكُ المَوارِدَ.
dialogue.tr: as-sababu l-ʾawwal: al-maṣāniʿu l-kabīratu allatī tanfuthu dukhānahā fī l-hawāʾi watulqī nifāyātihā fī l-ʾanhār, watastahliku l-mawārid.
dialogue.en: The first cause: big factories that blow their smoke into the air, throw their waste into rivers and use up resources.
dialogue.ur: Pehla sabab: bade karkhane jo apna dhuan hawa mein chhodte, apna kachra nadiyon mein daalte aur wasail khatam karte hain.

dialogue.ar: السَّبَبُ الثّاني: اسْتِعْمالُ الأَسْمِدَةِ وَالمُبيداتِ بِلا عِلْمٍ، فَتَتَسَمَّمُ التُّرْبَةُ وَالماءُ.
dialogue.tr: as-sababu th-thānī: stiʿmālu l-ʾasmidati wa-l-mubīdāti bilā ʿilmin, fatatasammamu t-turbatu wa-l-māʾ.
dialogue.en: The second cause: using fertilizers and pesticides without knowledge, so the soil and water become poisoned.
dialogue.ur: Doosra sabab: bina ilm ke khaad aur keera-maar dawaon ka istemal, jis se mitti aur pani zehreela ho jata hai.

dialogue.ar: السَّبَبُ الثّالِثُ: الحُروبُ؛ فَهِيَ تُحْرِقُ الغاباتِ وَتُلَوِّثُ الأَرْضَ وَالهَواءَ سَنَواتٍ طَويلَةً.
dialogue.tr: as-sababu th-thālith: al-ḥurūb; fahiya tuḥriqu l-ghābāti watulawwithu l-ʾarḍa wa-l-hawāʾa sanawātin ṭaūīlatan.
dialogue.en: The third cause: wars, which burn forests and pollute the earth and air for many years.
dialogue.ur: Teesra sabab: jangein, jo jungle jalati aur zameen aur hawa ko kai saal tak aaloodah rakhti hain.

dialogue.ar: فَلْنَزْرَعْ شَجَرَةً، وَلْنُوَفِّرِ الماءَ وَالكَهْرَباءَ، وَلْنُعَلِّمْ أَبْناءَنا حُبَّ الطَّبيعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: falnazraʿ shajaratan, walnuwaffiri l-māʾa wa-l-kahrabāʾ, walnuʿallim abnāʾanā ḥubba ṭ-ṭabīʿati.
dialogue.en: Let us plant a tree, save water and electricity, and teach our children to love nature.
dialogue.ur: Aayiye ek darakht lagayen, pani aur bijli bachayen aur apne bachchon ko fitrat se mohabbat sikhayen.

dialogue.ar: وَسُؤالُنا الكَبيرُ: كَيْفَ نُنَظِّمُ صِناعَتَنا دونَ أَنْ نَظْلِمَ الأَرْضَ الَّتي تَحْمِلُنا؟
dialogue.tr: wasuʾālunā l-kabīr: kayfa nunaẓẓimu ṣināʿatanā dūna an naẓlima l-ʾarḍa allatī taḥmilunā?
dialogue.en: And our big question: how do we organise our industry without wronging the earth that carries us?
dialogue.ur: Aur hamara bara sawal yeh hai: hum apni sanat ko kaise tarteeb dein ke us zameen par zulm na ho jo hamein uthaye hue hai?

q.en: Which is NOT one of the three causes of pollution in the text?
q.ur: Matn mein aaloodgi ke teen asbab mein se kaun sa sabab nahin hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ هذِهِ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَسْبابِ التَّلَوُّثِ الثَّلاثَةِ في النَّصِّ؟

q.en: According to the text, protecting the environment is the duty of:
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq mahaul ki hifazat kis ki zimmedari hai?
q.ar: حِمايَةُ البيئَةِ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ واجِبٌ عَلى:

q.ur: «Pahaar» ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني أَرْضاً عالِيَةً تَرْتَفِعُ فَوْقَ السَّهْلِ؟

q.en: The text says the sea is where:
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq samundar mein kya hota hai?
q.ar: يَقولُ النَّصُّ إِنَّ البَحْرَ هُوَ المَكانُ الَّذي:

options: we breathe / hum saans lete hain

title.en: Grammar (A): Nouns in the raised case (marfūʿāt)

intro.en: Some nouns take the 'raised' ending (ḍamma ـُ). They are: the subject-starter (mubtadaʾ), the predicate (khabar), the doer (fāʿil), the stand-in doer (nāʾib al-fāʿil), the name of كان and its sisters, the predicate of إنّ, and a follower of a raised noun. Example: «الشّاهِدانِ صادِقانِ» - 'the two witnesses are truthful'.
intro.ur: Kuch ismon par raf' (ضمّہ) aata hai: mubtada, khabar, faail, naib-e-faail, ism-e-kaana, khabar-e-inna aur marfu' ka tabe'. Misaal: «الشّاهِدانِ صادِقانِ» - 'dono gawah sachche hain'. Is sabaq mein hum inki misalein dekhte hain.
intro.ar: بَعْضُ الأَسْماءِ تَأْتي مَرْفوعَةً بِالضَّمَّةِ: المُبْتَدَأُ، وَالخَبَرُ، وَالفاعِلُ، وَنائِبُ الفاعِلِ، وَاسْمُ كانَ وَأَخَواتِها، وَخَبَرُ إِنَّ، وَالتّابِعُ لِمَرْفوعٍ. مِثالٌ: «الشّاهِدانِ صادِقانِ».

dialogue.ar: اللَّهُ لَطِيفٌ بِعِبَادِهِ.
dialogue.tr: Allāh laṭīfun biʿibādih.
dialogue.en: Allah is kind to His servants. (Allah = subject-starter, laṭīf = predicate)
dialogue.ur: Allah apne bandon par meherban hai. (Allah = mubtada, lateef = khabar)

dialogue.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ.
dialogue.tr: walaqad naṣarakumu Allāh bibadrin.
dialogue.en: And Allah helped you at Badr. (Allah = doer)
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah ne Badr mein tumhari madad ki. (Allah = faail)

dialogue.ar: غُلِبَتِ الرُّومُ.
dialogue.tr: ghulibati r-rūm.
dialogue.en: The Romans were defeated. (ar-Rūm = stand-in doer)
dialogue.ur: Rum ko shikast di gayi. (ar-Rum = naib-e-faail)

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ.
dialogue.tr: inna Allāh ghafūrun raḥīmun.
dialogue.en: Indeed Allah is Forgiving, Merciful. (ghafūr = predicate of inna)
dialogue.ur: Beshak Allah bakhshne wala meherban hai. (ghafoor = khabar-e-inna)

dialogue.ar: أَصْبَحَ التِّلْميذُ مُجْتَهِداً.
dialogue.tr: aṣbaḥa t-tilmīdhu mujtahidan.
dialogue.en: The pupil became hard-working. (ism of «أَصْبَحَ» = tilmeedh)
dialogue.ur: Shagird mehnati ban gaya. (ism-e-asbaha = shagird)

dialogue.ar: حَضَرَ الطّالِبُ المُجْتَهِدُ.
dialogue.tr: ḥaḍara ṭ-ṭālibu l-mujtahid.
dialogue.en: The hard-working student attended. («المُجْتَهِدُ» describes the raised noun)
dialogue.ur: Mehnati talib-e-ilm hazir hua. («المُجْتَهِدُ» marfu ki sifat)

dialogue.ar: العَدْلُ أَساسُ المُلْكِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿadlu asāsu l-mulk.
dialogue.en: Justice is the foundation of rule. (subject-starter + predicate)
dialogue.ur: Adl hukoomat ki bunyad hai. (mubtada + khabar)

dialogue.ar: فازَ الفَريقُ بِالمُسابَقَةِ.
dialogue.tr: fāza l-farīqu bi-l-musābaqati.
dialogue.en: The team won the competition. (doer)
dialogue.ur: Team muqable mein jeet gayi. (faail)

q.en: In «حَضَرَ الطّالِبُ المُجْتَهِدُ», what does «المُجْتَهِدُ» do?
q.ur: «حَضَرَ الطّالِبُ المُجْتَهِدُ» mein «المُجْتَهِدُ» ka kya kaam hai?

options: It describes the student / Talib ki sifat
The doer of the action / Kaam karne wala

q.ur: «العَدْلُ أَساسُ المُلْكِ» ka kya matlab hai?

options: Justice is the foundation of rule
Rule is the foundation of justice
options_ar: العَدْلُ هُوَ الأَساسُ الَّذي يَقومُ عَلَيْهِ الحُكْمُ

title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Miyan biwi ke ikhtilafat

intro.en: This lesson has two listening parts: the causes of marital disagreements and their effects. Listen to the audio, then mark each statement true or false and choose the right answers. Here we learn the key words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do sunne ke hisse hain: miyan biwi ke ikhtilafat ke asbab aur unke asraat. Audio sunein, phir har jumle ko sahi ya ghalat kahein aur sahi jawab chunein. Yahan hum aham alfaz seekhte hain.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ نَصّانِ لِلِاسْتِماعِ: أَسْبابُ الخِلافاتِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ وَآثارُها. اسْتَمِعْ ثُمَّ احْكُمْ عَلى كُلِّ جُمْلَةٍ بِصَحيحٍ أَوْ خَطَأٍ، وَاخْتَرِ الإِجاباتِ الصَّحيحَةَ. نَتَعَلَّمُ هُنا الكَلِماتِ الأَساسِيَّةَ.

dialogue.ar: حُسْنُ الاخْتِيارِ في الزَّواجِ يَحْمي البَيْتَ مِنْ كَثيرٍ مِنَ الخِلافاتِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥusnu l-ākhtiyāri fī z-zawāji yaḥmī l-bayta min kathīrin mina l-khilāfāt.
dialogue.en: Choosing well in marriage protects the home from many disagreements.
dialogue.ur: Shaadi mein achhi pasand ghar ko bohat se jhagdon se bachati hai.

dialogue.ar: يَنْبَغي لِلزَّوْجِ وَالزَّوْجَةِ أَنْ يَتَشاوَرا، فَالاسْتِشارَةُ تُقَرِّبُ القُلوبَ.
dialogue.tr: yanbaghī lilzzawji wa-z-zawjati an yatashāwarā, fa-l-āstishāratu tuqarribu l-qulūb.
dialogue.en: The husband and wife should consult each other, for consultation brings hearts closer.
dialogue.ur: Miyan biwi ko aapas mein mashwara karna chahiye, kyunke mashwara dilon ko qareeb karta hai.

dialogue.ar: غَلاءُ المُهورِ وَتَكاليفِ الزَّواجِ يُثْقِلُ كاهِلَ الشَّبابِ.
dialogue.tr: ghalāʾu l-muhūri watakālīfi z-zawāji yuthqilu kāhila sh-shabāb.
dialogue.en: The high price of dowries and wedding costs burdens the young.
dialogue.ur: Mehr aur shaadi ke akhrajaat ki giraani naujawanon par bojh daalti hai.

dialogue.ar: نَشْرُ أَسْرارِ البَيْتِ بَيْنَ النّاسِ يَزيدُ الخِلافَ بَيْنَ الزَّوْجَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: nashru asrāri l-bayti bayna n-nāsi yazīdu l-khilāfa bayna z-zawjayn.
dialogue.en: Spreading the secrets of the home among people increases the disagreement between the spouses.
dialogue.ur: Ghar ke raaz logon mein phailana miyan biwi ke jhagde ko barhata hai.

dialogue.ar: لِلخِلافاتِ الدّائِمَةِ آثارٌ سَلْبِيَّةٌ في الأَوْلادِ وَفي صِلَةِ الأَرْحامِ.
dialogue.tr: lilkhilāfāti d-dāʾimati ʾāthārun salbiyyatun fī l-ʾawlādi wafī ṣilati l-ʾarḥām.
dialogue.en: Constant disagreements have negative effects on the children and on keeping family ties.
dialogue.ur: Musalsal ikhtilafat ke bachchon par aur rishtedaron se milne julne par manfi asarat parte hain.

dialogue.ar: الحِوارُ الهادِئُ وَالصَّبْرُ مِفْتاحٌ لِحَلِّ المُشْكِلاتِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥwāru l-hādiʾu wa-ṣ-ṣabru miftāḥun liḥalli l-mushkilāti z-zawjiyyati.
dialogue.en: Calm dialogue and patience are a key to solving marital problems.
dialogue.ur: Pur-sukoon baat cheet aur sabr miyan biwi ke masail hal karne ki kunji hain.

options_ar: مَنْ نُحِبُّهُ وَنَثِقُ بِهِ مِنَ الرِّفاقِ

intro.en: Here we practise reciting poetry. The poem is Kaʿb ibn Zuhayr's famous ode «بانَتْ سُعادُ». Read the lines aloud slowly, then choose a poem you like, memorise part of it and recite it to your friends.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum shayri parhna seekhte hain. Nazm Kab bin Zuhair ka mashhoor qaseeda «بانَتْ سُعادُ» hai. Ashaar aahista aawaz se parhein, phir apni pasand ki nazm ka hissa yaad karke doston ko sunayein.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ هُنا عَلى إِنْشادِ الشِّعْرِ، وَالقَصيدَةُ هِيَ قَصيدَةُ كَعْبِ بْنِ زُهَيْرٍ المَشْهورَةُ «بانَتْ سُعادُ». اقْرَأِ الأَبْياتَ بِصَوْتٍ عالٍ وَبِبُطْءٍ، ثُمَّ اخْتَرْ قَصيدَةً تُحِبُّها وَاحْفَظْ جُزْءاً مِنْها وَأَنْشِدْهُ أَمامَ أَصْدِقائِكَ.

dialogue.ar: بانَتْ سُعادُ، فَقَلْبي اليَوْمَ مَتْبولُ.
dialogue.tr: bānat Suʿādu, fa-qalbī l-yawma matbūl
dialogue.en: Suʿād has gone far away, and my heart today is sick with love.
dialogue.ur: Suaad door chali gayi, aur aaj mera dil ishq mein bimar hai.

dialogue.ar: وَما سُعادُ غَداةَ البَيْنِ إِذْ رَحَلوا إِلّا أَغَنُّ غَضيضُ الطَّرْفِ مَكْحولُ.
dialogue.tr: wa mā Suʿādu ghadāta l-bayni idh raḥalū illā aghannu ghaḍīḍu ṭ-ṭarfi makḥūl
dialogue.en: On the morning of parting, when they left, Suʿād was only a soft-voiced one with lowered, kohl-lined eyes.
dialogue.ur: Judai ki subah jab woh rawana hue to Suaad narm aawaz, jhuki nazar aur surme wali aankhon wali thi.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الرَّسولَ لَنورٌ يُسْتَضاءُ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: inna r-rasūla la-nūrun yustaḍāʾu bih
dialogue.en: Indeed the Messenger is a light by which one is guided.
dialogue.ur: Beshak Rasool ek noor hain jis se roshni li jaati hai.

dialogue.ar: مُهَنَّدٌ مِنْ سُيوفِ اللهِ مَسْلولُ.
dialogue.tr: muhannadun min suyūfi llāhi maslūl
dialogue.en: A drawn Indian sword from the swords of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki talwaron mein se ek khinchi hui talwar.

dialogue.ar: وَالعَفْوُ عِنْدَ رَسولِ اللهِ مَأْمولُ.
dialogue.tr: wal-ʿafwu ʿinda rasūli llāhi maʾmūl
dialogue.en: And pardon is hoped for from the Messenger of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah ke Rasool se maafi ki umeed hai.

options_ar: كَلامٌ مَوْزونٌ مُقَفًّى يَتَأَلَّفُ مِنْ أَبْياتٍ

q.en: In the poem, the Messenger is described as:
q.ur: Nazm mein Rasool ko kya kaha gaya?

title.en: Grammar (B): Nouns in the accusative case (manṣūbāt)

intro.en: Some nouns take the 'opened' ending (fatḥa ـَ). They include: the object (مفعول به), the absolute object, the object of purpose, the time/place adverb, the name of إنّ, the predicate of كان, the exception, the state (ḥāl), the specification (tamyīz) and a follower of a manṣūb. Example: «سَهِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ» - 'I stayed up with the moon'.
intro.ur: Kuch ism fatha (ـَ) ke saath aate hain. Un mein hain: maf'ool bihi, maf'ool mutlaq, maf'ool lahu, zarf-e-zaman o makan, ism-e-inna, khabar-e-kaana, mustasna, haal, tamyeez aur mansoob ka taabe'. Misal: «سَهِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ» - 'main chand ke saath jaagta raha'.
intro.ar: بَعْضُ الأَسْماءِ تَأْتي مَنْصوبَةً بِالفَتْحَةِ، مِنْها: المَفْعولُ بِهِ، وَالمَفْعولُ المُطْلَقُ، وَالمَفْعولُ لِأَجْلِهِ، وَظَرْفا الزَّمانِ وَالمَكانِ، وَاسْمُ إِنَّ، وَخَبَرُ كانَ، وَالمُسْتَثْنى، وَالحالُ، وَالتَّمْييزُ، وَالتّابِعُ لِمَنْصوبٍ. مِثالٌ: «سَهِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ».

dialogue.ar: لِّيَجْزِيَ اللَّهُ الصَّادِقِينَ بِصِدْقِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: liyajziya Allāh ṣ-ṣādiqīna biṣidqihim.
dialogue.en: So that Allah rewards the truthful for their truthfulness. (ṣādiqīn = object)
dialogue.ur: Taake Allah sachchon ko unke sach ka badla de. (sadiqeen = maf'ool bihi)

dialogue.ar: إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُّبِينًا.
dialogue.tr: innā fataḥnā laka fatḥanā mubīnanā.
dialogue.en: We have given you a clear victory. (fatḥan = absolute object)
dialogue.ur: Humne aap ko khuli fatah di. (fathan = maf'ool mutlaq)

dialogue.ar: وَادْعُوهُ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا.
dialogue.tr: wādʿūhu khawfanā waṭamaʿanā.
dialogue.en: And call upon Him in fear and hope. (object of purpose)
dialogue.ur: Aur usay khauf aur ummeed se pukaro. (maf'ool li-ajlihi)

dialogue.ar: سَهِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ.
dialogue.tr: sahirtu wa-l-qamar.
dialogue.en: I stayed up along with the moon. (object of accompaniment)
dialogue.ur: Main chand ke saath jaagta raha. (maf'ool ma'ahu)

dialogue.ar: وَكَانَ اللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا.
dialogue.tr: wakāna Allāh ghafūranā raḥīmanā.
dialogue.en: And Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful. (ghafūran = predicate of kāna)
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah bakhshne wala meherban hai. (ghafooran = khabar-e-kaana)

dialogue.ar: قَالَتَا أَتَيْنَا طَائِعِينَ.
dialogue.tr: qālatā ataynā ṭāʾiʿīn.
dialogue.en: The two said: we have come willingly. (ṭāʾiʿīn = state)
dialogue.ur: Dono ne kaha: hum farmanbardari se aaye. (taa'ieen = haal)

dialogue.ar: فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا.
dialogue.tr: falabitha fīhim alfa sanatin illā khamsīna ʿāmanā.
dialogue.en: He stayed among them a thousand years less fifty years. (exception)
dialogue.ur: Woh unmein hazaar saal rahe siwaye pachas saal ke. (mustasna)

dialogue.ar: شَكَرَ الطّالِبُ مُعَلِّمَهُ.
dialogue.tr: shakara ṭ-ṭālibu muʿallimah.
dialogue.en: The student thanked his teacher. (direct object)
dialogue.ur: Talib-e-ilm ne apne ustaad ka shukriya ada kiya. (maf'ool bihi)

dialogue.ar: خالِدٌ أَطْوَلُ مِنْ أَخيهِ قامَةً.
dialogue.tr: khālidun aṭwalu min akhīhi qāmatan.
dialogue.en: Khalid is taller than his brother in height. (specification)
dialogue.ur: Khalid apne bhai se qad mein lamba hai. (tamyeez)

options_ar: العُضْوُ الَّذي يَضُخُّ الدَّمَ في الجِسْمِ

q.en: In «سَهِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ», the word «القَمَرَ» ends with fatḥa because it is:
q.ur: «سَهِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ» mein «القَمَرَ» fatha ke saath kyun hai?
q.ar: في «سَهِرْتُ وَالقَمَرَ» جاءَتْ «القَمَرَ» مَنْصوبَةً بِالفَتْحَةِ لِأَنَّها:

q.ur: Mansub ism aam taur par kis par khatam hote hain?

q.en: In «إِلّا خَمْسينَ عامًا», the word after «إِلّا» is called:
q.ur: «إِلّا» ke baad aane wale lafz ko kya kehte hain?
q.ar: في «إِلّا خَمْسينَ عاماً» تُسَمّى الكَلِمَةُ بَعْدَ «إِلّا»:

intro.en: A story about a poor fisherman who is truly content. A visitor meets him by the river at dawn and asks how a man can be happy while poor. The fisherman gives wise answers about contentment, trust in Allah and fate. Read each paragraph, then answer the questions.
intro.ur: Ek gareeb machhere ki kahani jo dil se raazi hai. Ek mulaqati fajr ke waqt nadi par us se milta hai aur poochta hai ke gareeb aadmi khush kaise reh sakta hai. Machhera qanaat, tawakkul aur taqdeer ke bare mein daanai bhare jawab deta hai. Har hissa parhein phir sawalat ke jawab dein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةٌ عَنْ صَيّادٍ فَقيرٍ راضٍ بِحالِهِ حَقّاً. يَلْقاهُ زائِرٌ عَلى النَّهْرِ عِنْدَ الفَجْرِ وَيَسْأَلُهُ: كَيْفَ يَكونُ الإِنْسانُ سَعيداً وَهُوَ فَقيرٌ؟ فَيُجيبُهُ الصَّيّادُ بِأَجْوِبَةٍ حَكيمَةٍ عَنِ القَناعَةِ وَالتَّوَكُّلِ عَلى اللهِ وَالقَدَرِ. اقْرَأْ كُلَّ فِقْرَةٍ ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ.

dialogue.ar: خَرَجْتُ عِنْدَ الفَجْرِ أَتَمَشّى عَلى ضِفَّةِ النَّهْرِ، فَرَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً عَجوزاً يَجْلِسُ وَقَدْ نَشَرَ شَبَكَتَهُ.
dialogue.tr: kharajtu ʿinda l-fajri atamashshā ʿalā ḍiffati n-nahr, faraʾaytu rajulan ʿajūzan yajlisu waqad nashara shabakatah.
dialogue.en: I went out at dawn to walk on the bank of the river, and saw an old man sitting, his net spread out.
dialogue.ur: Main fajr ke waqt nadi ke kinare tehalne nikla to ek boorha aadmi dekha jo apna jaal phailaye baitha tha.

dialogue.ar: السَّلامُ عَلَيْكَ يا عَمّ، أَراكَ مُبْتَسِماً، فَهَلْ كانَ الصَّيْدُ كَثيراً؟
dialogue.tr: as-salāmu ʿalayka yā ʿamm, arāka mubtasiman, fahal kāna ṣ-ṣaydu kathīran?
dialogue.en: Peace be upon you, uncle. I see you smiling; was the catch plentiful?
dialogue.ur: Assalamu alaikum chacha, aap muskura rahe hain; kya shikar bohat mila?

dialogue.ar: وَعَلَيْكَ السَّلامُ يا بُنَيَّ. صَيْدي قَليلٌ، وَلَكِنَّني أَشْكُرُ اللهَ؛ فَما يَدْخُلُ شَبَكَتي يَكْفيني وَيَكْفي أَهْلي.
dialogue.tr: waʿalayka s-salāmu yā bunayya. ṣaydī qalīlun, walakinnanī ashkuru Allā; famā yadkhulu shabakatī yakfīnī wayakfī ahlī.
dialogue.en: And peace be upon you, my son. My catch is small, but I thank Allah; what enters my net is enough for me and my family.
dialogue.ur: Wa alaikum assalam beta. Mera shikar kam hai magar main Allah ka shukr karta hoon; jo jaal mein aata hai woh mere liye aur mere ghar walon ke liye kaafi hai.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّكَ فَقيرٌ يا عَمّ! أَلا تَحْلُمُ بِقَصْرٍ مِثْلِ قُصورِ الأَغْنِياءِ؟
dialogue.tr: lākinnaka faqīrun yā ʿamm! alā taḥlumu biqaṣrin mithli quṣūri l-ʾaghniyāʾ?
dialogue.en: But you are poor, uncle! Do you not dream of a palace like the palaces of the rich?
dialogue.ur: Magar aap to gareeb hain chacha! Kya aap ameeron ke mahalon jaisa mahal ka khwab nahin dekhte?

dialogue.ar: وَما نَفْعُ القُصورِ إِذا سَكَنَها الخَوْفُ وَالقَلَقُ؟ أَنا أَنامُ نَوْمَةً هادِئَةً لا يَعْرِفُها كَثيرٌ مِنَ الأَغْنِياءِ.
dialogue.tr: wamā nafʿu l-quṣūri idhā sakanahā l-khawfu wa-l-qalaq? anā anāmu nawmatan hādiʾatan lā yaʿrifuhā kathīrun mina l-ʾaghniyāʾ.
dialogue.en: What use are palaces if fear and worry live in them? I sleep a calm sleep that many rich people do not know.
dialogue.ur: Un mahalon ka kya faida agar un mein khauf aur pareshani rehti ho? Main aisi pur-sukoon neend sota hoon jo bohat se ameer nahin jaante.

dialogue.ar: وَما سِرُّ هَذِهِ السَّعادَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: wamā sirru hādhihi s-saʿādati?
dialogue.en: And what is the secret of this happiness?
dialogue.ur: Aur is khushi ka raaz kya hai?

dialogue.ar: القَناعَةُ يا بُنَيَّ. مَنْ رَضِيَ بِما قَسَمَ اللهُ لَهُ عاشَ مُطْمَئِنّاً، وَمَنْ طَمِعَ فيما عِنْدَ النّاسِ شَقِيَ.
dialogue.tr: al-qanāʿatu yā bunayya. man raḍiya bimā qasama Allāh lahu ʿāsha muṭmaʾinnan, waman ṭamiʿa fīmā ʿinda n-nāsi shaqiy.
dialogue.en: Contentment, my son. Whoever is pleased with what Allah divided for him lives at ease, and whoever covets what others have becomes wretched.
dialogue.ur: Qanaat beta. Jo Allah ke diye par raazi ho woh sukoon se jeeta hai aur jo doosron ke paas ki cheezon par lalach kare woh bad-bakht ho jata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا أُؤْمِنُ بِالقَضاءِ وَالقَدَرِ؛ أَسْعى وَأَرْمي شَبَكَتي، وَأَتْرُكُ النَّتيجَةَ لِرَبّي.
dialogue.tr: waʾanā uʾminu bi-l-qaḍāʾi wa-l-qadar; asʿā waʾarmī shabakatī, waʾatruku n-natījata lirabbī.
dialogue.en: And I believe in the divine decree and fate; I strive and cast my net, and leave the result to my Lord.
dialogue.ur: Aur main qaza o qadar par imaan rakhta hoon; koshish karta hoon, jaal daalta hoon aur nateeja apne Rab par chhor deta hoon.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ حَسَدَكَ أَحَدٌ يَوْماً أَوْ ظَلَمَكَ؟
dialogue.tr: wahal ḥasadaka aḥadun yawman aw ẓalamak?
dialogue.en: And has anyone ever envied you or wronged you?
dialogue.ur: Kya kisi ne kabhi aap se hasad kiya ya aap par zulm kiya?

dialogue.ar: الحاسِدُ وَالطَّمّاعُ وَالظّالِمُ هُمُ الأَشْقِياءُ، لِأَنَّ قُلوبَهُمْ لا تَهْدَأُ. أَمّا حُسْنُ الأَخْلاقِ فَهُوَ غِنًى لا يَنْفَدُ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥāsidu wa-ṭ-ṭammāʿu wa-ẓ-ẓālimu humu l-ʾashqiyāʾ, liʾanna qulūbahum lā tahdaʾ. ammā ḥusnu l-ʾakhlāqi fahuwa ghinanā lā yanfad.
dialogue.en: The envious, the greedy and the unjust are the wretched ones, because their hearts never rest. As for good character, it is a wealth that never runs out.
dialogue.ur: Hasad karne wala, lalchi aur zalim hi bad-bakht hain, kyunke un ke dil sukoon nahin paate. Rahi achhe akhlaaq ki baat, to woh aisi daulat hai jo khatam nahin hoti.

dialogue.ar: كَلامٌ جَميلٌ يا عَمّ، لَقَدْ تَعَلَّمْتُ مِنْكَ دَرْساً لَنْ أَنْساهُ.
dialogue.tr: kalāmun jamīlun yā ʿamm, laqad taʿallamtu minka darsan lan ansāh.
dialogue.en: Beautiful words, uncle; I have learned a lesson from you that I will not forget.
dialogue.ur: Bohat khoob baat chacha, aap se main ne ek aisa sabaq seekha jo kabhi nahin bhoolunga.

dialogue.ar: اذْهَبْ يا بُنَيَّ، وَاطْلُبِ السَّعادَةَ في نَفْسِكَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُبَها في المَدينَةِ.
dialogue.tr: dhhab yā bunayya, wāṭlubi s-saʿādata fī nafsika qabla an taṭlubahā fī l-madīnati.
dialogue.en: Go, my son, and seek happiness in yourself before you seek it in the city.
dialogue.ur: Jao beta, khushi ko pehle apne andar talash karo phir shehar mein.

dialogue.ar: في أَمانِ اللهِ يا عَمّ، وَجَزاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً عَلى نَصيحَتِكَ.
dialogue.tr: fī amāni Allāh yā ʿamm, wajazāka Allāh khayran ʿalā naṣīḥatik.
dialogue.en: In Allah's protection, uncle, and may Allah reward you well for your advice.
dialogue.ur: Khuda hafiz chacha, aur Allah aap ko apni nasihat ka behtareen badla de.

q.en: In the story, where does the fisherman sit at dawn?
q.ur: Kahani mein machhera fajr ke waqt kahan baithta hai?
q.ar: أَيْنَ يَجْلِسُ الصَّيّادُ عِنْدَ الفَجْرِ في القِصَّةِ؟

options: on the river bank / nadi ke kinare

q.en: According to the fisherman, where should happiness be sought first?
q.ur: Machhere ke mutabiq khushi pehle kahan talash karni chahiye?
q.ar: أَيْنَ يَجِبُ أَنْ نَطْلُبَ السَّعادَةَ أَوَّلاً بِحَسَبِ الصَّيّادِ؟

options: in wealth only / sirf daulat mein
the envious person / hasad karne wala
options_ar: الَّذي يَتَمَنّى زَوالَ النِّعْمَةِ عَنْ غَيْرِهِ

options: May Allah reward you well for your advice
